items.body: Band: Nostalghia | Album: Departure | Genre: Progressive metal | Year: 2026 From: Mexico City, Mexico | Label: Independent For fans of: Opeth, Enslaved, Riverside Bandcamp Nostalghia is a one-man project helmed by Mexican multi-instrumentalist Alex Becerra. This album is my first exposure to Nostalghia, but it looks like this is a very prolific project. According to RYM, this Departure is Nostalghia’s 14th release since their debut in 2020. The music on this record is stunningly diverse and ambitious. Aside from the band’s black metal roots, jazz, classical, alt-rock, classic prog, and more all play important parts here. “Leaving” opens the album on a restrained note. Acoustic guitar lines weave around one another in a way that draws from Baroque composers. When the vocals enter, they’re restrained. Rattling percussion, anxious strings, and tinkling piano build a sense of claustrophobia before suddenly cutting out and giving way to a melodic, piano-led passage that flows directly into the more-immediately-impactful opening of “Dearly Departed”. Riverside and Enslaved are both obvious influences in this song, with rapid, wiry guitar runs and vocals that vacillate between soulful and harsh. Latin jazz emerges about midway through as a nice bit of contrast. Many acts attempting such an incorporation come off as hokey and ham-fisted, but Nostalghia’s composition feels coherent and thought-out. The opening of “Uróboros” features some chamber music influence alongside restrained proggy folk, akin to acts like Jordsjø or Änglagård. When metal eventually emerges, there’s a wonderful, blistering solo supported by rich string arrangements. This sort of metal-classical hybrid is a not-uncommon trope in the realm of prog, but few acts pull it off this well. “Qa Muqu”, sung in a Mayan language and directly adapted from the Popol Vuh, has a peppy, jazzy opening. Enslaved-flavored black metal propels this piece along, with brass and piano exclamation points throughout. During instrumental passages, jazz once more comes to the forefront, and time signatures and rhythms get wonky as hell. The transitions between heavy and gentle moments are often sudden, but it all feels earned. Somber piano opens “Wherever You Are”. This is a mellow piece overall that gives the listener some appreciated breathing room. Riverside, Porcupine Tree, and Dream Theater’s better slow songs are all clear influences on this piece. “The Abyss Whispered” jumps back into metal, and tinkling chimes give it a celestial, otherworldly feel. The arrangements of the different parts of this song are diverse and complex, with some parts leaning into harsh black metal and others utilizing dissonant modern classical music. The final song on the album is the 10-minute “Offret (including “Ashes upon Eden”, “By the Corpse of Earth” and “Mercy”)”. “Ashes upon Earth” is led by clean guitar and pulls in elements of classical and dark folk music. I especially get flashes of some of Agalloch’s mellower output here. As distortion builds, so does the sense of majesty, before suddenly cutting out in the transition to “By the Corpse of the Earth”. Muted, atonal strings pluck and plink awkwardly and hauntingly, like the score to a horror film. Rattling chains and distant piano add to the ambiance. In the hands of less-skilled composers, this movement could easily become grating, but Becerra sells the tension and the anxiety. The final movement, “Mercy”, leans heavily upon ethereal atmospherics, with angelic vocals lifting everything skyward. Departure is a moving piece of music that displays an impressive breadth and depth of musical knowledge and skill. The songs demonstrate complex and technical instrumental ability, while the structures manage to be both diverse and coherent. The fusion of jazz and classical feels impressively natural, and I know there is a ton to discover upon repeated listens. Score: 92/100

items._cn_summary: Nostalghia 是一位墨西哥独立音乐人的单人多乐器项目，《Departure》展现出极高的创作野心，将前卫金属的黑色根源与爵士、古典、室内乐、民谣乃至拉丁爵士广泛融合。专辑以巴洛克式原声吉他开篇，在幽闭的紧张感与钢琴主导的旋律段落间交替推进。曲目编排跨越多种语言与文化语境，包括以玛雅语演唱、取自《波波尔乌》的段落，融入了复杂节奏与铜管点缀。重金属段落常以突然但有据可循的方式与柔美乐段衔接，结尾的十分钟长曲进一步展开多乐章结构。整体编曲强调器乐多样性与跨类型连贯性，虽涉猎广泛但组合逻辑清晰。

items.excerpt: Colin Stetson’s breakthrough album of gripping bass sax innovations still buzzes like few others. items.body:
Colin Stetson’s breakthrough album of gripping bass sax innovations still buzzes like few others.

In 2007 ‘New History Warfare Vol.1’ asserted Stetson as an indomitable player of wind instruments, here letting off on Alto, Baritone and Bass Saxophones, plus Clarinet, in a deftly muscular display of his skills which had previously been employed on record and in live tours for Arcade Fire, Tom Waits, Bon Iver, LCD Soundsystem and whoever the heck else needed a set of lungs as good as a blacksmith’s bellows.

While perhaps best known for wielding a massive Bass Saxophone that's responsible for some of the wildest sounds on this album, Stetson proves to be a sensitive beast capable of articulating the instrument’s full range tonal in his own voice, which variously comes out resembling a purring big cat and the dying wildebeest it just stalked, attacked and slaughtered in ‘Time Is Advancing With Fitful Irregularity’, while he uses the same broad tone to describe natural scenes as textured with soil and moisture and wind as an Anne Guthrie piece in ‘As a Bird or Branch’, while ‘Nobu Take’ sounds like a manic 8-bit computer game soundtrack and ’Tiger Tiger Crane’ adds a tight percussive workout for good measure, but trust its all acoustic, instrumental, hands-on, somehow not processed. 

Still a stonking good record, this, ripe for re/discovery.
items._genre: experimental / avant-garde jazz / solo saxophone / acoustic improvisation
items._cn_summary: 这张专辑以低音萨克斯为核心，展现了独奏管乐器的极限可能性。演奏者在无任何电子处理的情况下，仅凭循环呼吸技术同时吹奏与拾音，创造出层次丰富的复调效果。低音萨克斯的低频咆哮与中音萨克斯的尖锐泛音交替出现，既有野兽般的粗粝质感，也有树枝间鸟鸣般的纤细纹理。整张专辑横跨多重情绪：从猛烈的打击节奏到田野录音般的自然声响描绘，从八位机游戏音效到沉稳的冥想段落。值得注意的是，这些声音完全源自真实乐器的物理演奏，没有任何后期处理，这种纯粹的器乐实验在当代独立音乐中相当罕见。作为演奏者曾与拱廊之火、汤姆·韦茨等乐队合作的背景下，此作体现了他从伴奏者到独立艺术家的转型野心。

items.body:
Roy Montgomery and Martha Skye Murphy extend their thing on 'Nebular', penning a suite of widescreen dreampop epics that harness all their separate strengths into a fizzing artmelt -  tipped FFO Cocteau Twins & Harold Budd, Flying Saucer Attack, Jessamine and lovesliescrushing.

It didn't take much for Montgomery and Murphy to connect. All Murphy did was include one of Mongomery's songs on a mixtape and the conversations that followed led them to spot harmonies in their approaches to music: they both recorded to a Tascam multitrack recorder, for one. And if you've been following either artist, you'll have noticed their collaborations bubbling up through the cracks in the last few years. Murphy appeared on Montgomery's lush 'At Dawn' lathe cut 7" in 2023 and on his 2024 Roy Montgomery and Friends album 'Broken Heart Surgery (An Agony In Six Fits)', while Montgomery lent his distinct tone to Murphy's 2024 debut album 'Um', playing on the excellent 'Need'. It was all leading up to 'Nebular'; the two artists might be based on opposite sides of the globe, with Montgomery in New Zealand and Murphy in the UK, but they sound fully converged on this perfectly-pruned five tracker, developing a sound that's both related to their respective solo signatures and presents something new, too.

Montgomery's well-worn tone is present, forming a pillowy bed of post-Florian Fricke ambiance, yet it doesn't sound like any of his recent releases. And although Murphy's powerful, operatic tones were just as crucial to the success of 'Um', they're used differently here, reshaped into elongated, wordless traces and textures. Somehow, as weighty as it is, it works like a lengthy introduction before 'Nebular' asserts itself in earnest on 'Cloudburst'. Singing more confidently, Murphy augments her breathy vocals with stacked, dreamy textures that wisp and wind around Montgomery's strums. Maybe we can link it to Grouper or possibly even Julia Holter, but the way the duo treat the mixing and recording makes it sound older and grungier, like some lost 4AD release that never made it to the pressing plant.

The record hinges around the 17-minute 'The Play of Light and Dark', a side of rhythmic, chiming ambience from Montgomery that Murphy helps sculpt into a muggy mantra, vocalising unrestrainedly and shaping a sound that's refreshingly human. It doesn't shift so much as it melts, changing only slightly to draw you into its aura. When Mary Lattimore shows up on the finale 'At Dusk', it's a gorgeous, necessary palate cleanser.
items._cn_summary: Roy Montgomery与Martha Skye Murphy合作的专辑通过Tascam多轨录音机这一共同媒介产生联结，将两人的创作风格融合成宽幅音景作品。Montgomery标志性的后摇氛围底色与Murphy强大的歌唱能力在此被重新塑形，后者原本戏剧化的声乐被转化为无词的绵长音色与质感。整张专辑以五首曲目展开，十七分钟的《The Play of Light and Dark》为核心，呈现节奏化的钟鸣氛围与人声吟唱交织的沉浸式体验。结尾由Mary Lattimore的竖琴演奏收束，作为情绪过渡。整体制作带有4AD前辈厂牌的复古质感，在两者各自独立创作脉络的基础上发展出新的融合方向。

items.body:
Steve Rachmad's "Light And Time" via Dekmantel.

"Making a bold change of direction as he toasts 45 years working in electronic music, Steve Rachmad dials up the symphonic dimension of his musical practice for Light and Time — a widescreen trip to techno's outer reaches. As one of the true originators of Dutch dance music, Rachmad brings a wealth of experience to his first album for Dekmantel even as he adopts new production methods to create his most ambient body of work to date.

A strong melodic sensibility runs through all of Rachmad's work. His 1995 album The Secret Life Of Machines under his Sterac alias remains a landmark of lush, emotionally charged, deep-diving techno, while classic workouts like 'Helix' and 'Gnosis' (as Parallel 9) foregrounded powerful synth lines. Up until the upheaval of COVID, Rachmad's studio practice had been squarely focused on synths and drum machines, but when (along with the rest of the world) he was stuck at home reevaluating his situation, he found himself exploring the world of film scoring.

Experimenting with Native Instruments' sampling software Kontakt, Rachmad taught himself how to arrange and layer orchestral instrumentation. Having rarely used sampling in his music before, the distinct fluctuations of recorded orchestral players opened up a new dimension that has become the foundation of Light and Time, the first of many albums Rachmad has ready to go in a more downtempo, home-listening vein.

Throughout Light and Time, harmonious passages take centre stage as Rachmad audibly stretches out. At times the orchestral samples arrive in a pure, organic form, while elsewhere they merge and mutate into synthesised elements. His techno legacy manifests throughout, in abstract form. In lieu of strident beats, we're offered fractal, scratchy rhythms guiding uniquely shaped noise and natural sounding percussion with a human lilt. These fluctuations are no accident — they're a result of Rachmad playing much more of the album by hand after years in thrall to the precise machine pulse of arpeggios and sequences.

The album never feels restricted by one dogmatic approach. At times, Rachmad's embrace of moody soundtrack composition fills the whole picture, as on haunting string piece 'The Field Of Reality'. Elsewhere he dips into low-slung electro soul for 'Invisible Warriors Of Light' while 'Cosmic Memories' revels in alien synthesis with a dramatic bite. 'Encrypted Instructions' tweaks and processes string samples through angular prisms to close the album out with an experimental flourish.

Rachmad's long and winding history in electronic music naturally folds into these new modes of expression, and the end result is a sumptuous, many-sided album that showcases the hidden depths of a techno legend's musicality."
items._cn_summary: Steve Rachmad在从业四十五年后推出转型之作，首次大幅引入交响乐编制。他自学Kontakt采样软件，将管弦乐录音样本层层叠加，与合成器音色交融，形成既有机又数字化的声响质感。专辑脱离了传统techno的规整节拍，转而采用分形化、带有手工演奏痕迹的不规则节奏，并融合低频电子灵魂乐与外星合成器段落。弦乐如《The Field Of Reality》以电影配乐式的氛围铺展，结尾曲则将弦乐样本经过棱角分明的棱镜式处理收束全篇。整张专辑是techno元老对自身创作语汇的延伸与重塑，展现了从舞池到居家聆听场景的转变，以及将古典管弦乐元素融入电子音乐框架的探索成果。

items.body:
Quietly unheimlich, slowcore dream-pop transformations of Western and Japanese kids’ music by a nascent Osaka duo for Em Records...weird and wonderful like some lost hookup between Tennoscoats, Colleen and Félicia Atkinson...

"The terms “nursery rhymes” and “children’s songs” may give rise to visions of idyllic innocence and the charms of childhood, but Play Nursery Rhymes and Children's Songs brings forth quite different aural imagery: this is an eerie and unsettling sonic picture book which hints at the darkness and mystery which form the hidden heart of many traditional songs and rhymes. The length of the songs provides a hint: each piece delves deeply into the latent uncanniness of the music, with superficial innocence gradually displaced as electric guitar, bass, field recordings and concrete sounds draw the listener into a chilly forest, while Tokiyo Ooto’s voice croons dark “lullabies for adults,” blending elements of folk, slowcore and dream pop.

The Tokiyo Ooto & Orhythmo duo formed in 2023, releasing their first album in 2024. This release updates two pieces from the first album, and also includes a traditional Japanese children’s song from Shiga Prefecture and a masterpiece for children by composer Yasushi Akutagawa. Both musicians are Osaka-based: Otoo is a guitarist and singer-songwriter who also works in band and solo contexts; Orhythmo is a bassist with hardcore punk roots who focuses on improvisation, drone, noise and ambient sound."
items._cn_summary: 这张专辑对西方与日本童谣进行了深度解构，由大阪二人组Tokiyo Ooto与Orhythmo在Em Records厂牌下完成。作品跳脱童谣的甜美表层，深入挖掘传统歌谣中潜藏的黑暗与神秘质地。电吉他、贝斯、田野录音与具体音乐声响交织，将听者引入一片冷寂的声景森林。主唱Tokiyo Ooto的声线化为成人摇篮曲，融合民谣、慢核与梦幻流行的元素。专辑收录两首首张专辑的更新版本、一首滋贺县传统日本童谣以及作曲家武满彻的儿童音乐作品（应为芥川也寸志）。Orhythmo出身自硬核朋克背景，转向即兴、 Drone、噪声与氛围领域，与Ooto的吉他创作形成对话，呈现出具有实验意识的童谣重构。

items._cn_summary: 《Boca De Acero》是阿根廷人声艺术家 Ines Terra 与乌拉圭吉他手 Santiago Bogacz 的二重奏专辑，全长五个乐章均以即兴方式完成。乐评开篇即指出作品以爆破性的引子开场，并在整张专辑中保持紧绷的张力直至终了。两人虽来自南美不同国家，却展现出无缝的默契协作，呈现出抽象而富于画面感的音乐对话，乐评用「cinematic conversation」来形容其流动的叙事感。专辑将人声的延展性与吉他的即兴纹理并置，脱离了传统歌曲结构，转向纯粹的声响探索与情绪互动。对于关注即兴、实验人声以及器乐对话的听众而言，这是一次值得深入聆听的双人录音，展现了南美即兴场景中跨地域合作的活力与深度。

items.body: For an overview of the what, the why, and the where of this music, do read my review of Volume 1 of this series. Essentially, this collection is more of what made Volume 1 so infectious. Yet, what makes this music so fascinating in general, that is, beyond its unswerving ability to fill dance floors, is the fact that these two islands, part of the Paises Africanos de Lingua Oficial Portuguesa (PALOP) regions of the world, are the second smallest African country; Seychelles is smaller. There are only 12 villages on Sao Tom�, lots of rain forest and, not surprisingly, lots of rain. I mention this because one could be fooled into thinking, with music like what�s on offer here, there must have been a music scene larger than there actually was. Not that little was happening, but that less got recorded or released than it might have had there been a city such as Lagos or Nairobi with the studios, labels, and pressing plants to better document it all. The music here, like Volume 1- recorded during Africa�s so-called golden age- is known as Puxa, a complex stew of ingredients from other former African Portuguese colonies mixed with rhythms that, with the help of dancers, can summon spirits or exorcise demons. At least according to some. It�s worth knowing that a 100 years or so ago, the Portuguese banned Puxa dance; it�s also worth knowing they appear to have failed miserably at this silly endeavor. Tucked away in modern Puxa is merengue, Kompas, Soukouss, Benga, and much else. One suspects much of this is coincidental, while other grooves were definitely imported considering both Portuguese rule and the islands� location over the Atlantic from the Caribbean. But don�t be fooled into thinking these two islands don�t have their own thing, as the sounds on this collection show. L�VE L�VE Vol. 2: Sao Tom� & Principe Sounds 70s-80s - Pedro Lima Pedro Lima, who has featured in his own Bongo Joe collection, leads a fiery band, complete with choked guitar vamps tussling with a kit drummer as a lead guitar comments from the sidelines on �Sossegado.� Elsewhere, Sangazuza demonstrates what happens when the bass and keys drop out, leaving the drummers and guitars to ride out a groove and drive dancers mad in the process. Check �Sono s� ku� de t�ma� or �Mairo bi cedo� for their ability to place a firm finger on the pulse. Over 15 tracks, the collection shows off multiple guitars weaving and circling one another, with lead and harmony vocals constantly in response, becoming part of the songs� melodic framework. At any given moment, vocals give way as the music unspools and floats on grooves that must have gone on for hours live. Africa Negra�s �Apoi�mos a luta dos nossos irm�os� is one example. L�VE L�VE Vol. 2: Sao Tom� & Principe Sounds 70s-80s by Various Artists In general, what�s on offer here, like Volume 1, was recorded at Radio Sao Tom� e Principe (RSTP), often taped in the courtyard outside at night, and released on cassette or occasionally, vinyl. It captures the joy of post-1975 independence and only fizzled out as styles changed and musicians struggled to make ends meet. Yet, take a quick listen to recent RSTP programming, which features musicians such as Babilonia or Calema, and you�ll still hear Puxa rhythms, showing just how potent the music form this two-island nation is on a global level. And Bongo Joe, who have also released two volumes featuring the above mentioned Africa Negra, have given this music the treatment it deserves, with extensive notes on the country�s history, vintage photographs, and band discographies. Various Artists - L�ve L�ve (Volume1) (Review) Pedro Lima - Maguidala (Review) Ann O'aro - Bleu (Review)

items._cn_summary: 该评论介绍的是圣多美和普林西比这两个非洲小岛在70至80年代录制的Puxa舞曲合集。Puxa是一种融合了前葡萄牙非洲殖民地多种音乐元素的复杂风格，夹杂merengue、Kompas、Soukouss、Benga等节奏特征，据说与召唤灵魂或驱赶恶魔的舞蹈仪式相关。葡殖民者曾以舞蹈过于淫靡为由禁止Puxa，但显然收效甚微。文章指出，由于这两个岛屿面积小、没有大城市和录音工业，许多音乐未能被记录下来，使这些存世录音更显珍贵。合集收录15首曲目，展现了多层吉他编织、主唱与和声之间的呼应关系，以及贝斯与键盘退出时鼓与吉他主导的疯狂律动。评论还提及Pedro Lima领衔的乐队、Sangazuza以及Africa Negra等艺人的代表曲目，认为这些音乐曾在现场被反复延长演奏数小时。

items.body: A confession to begin: I�ve been a fan of Alison Cotton�s music for quite a while, so the announcement of a new album definitely brought me a frisson of delight. The Gods Laugh certainly doesn�t disappoint, with the same deliciously amorphous feel that�s defined her other work, drawing on folk, the avant-garde, as well as a sense of religiosity to make the music here, possibly best exemplified in �I Am!�, where she set a poem by John Clare, England�s great nature poet, to a transcendent melody over the constant underpinning of a lulling drone. While the playing revolves around her usual arsenal of viola, harmonium, hammered dulcimer, and piano, along with some percussion, on this album she also adds some drums, bass and synthesizer. The music is often improvised and captured in a single take, with an almost mystical, hushed sensibility that seems to reach through time, as with �I Still Know You are Calling My Name,� where the tune could have been plucked from an old folk song. Sprigs of Heather by Alison Cotton The centerpiece, however, is �Sprigs of Heather,� with an opening that recalls medieval sacred music that becomes a simple, slowly cascading, piano-led melody. It�s far from the longest track on the album, but a little pearl of perfection that carries the listener away. Sprigs of Heather by Alison Cotton The Gods Laugh is a memorial of sorts to Cotton�s father, who died in late 2024. There�s a sense of loss reaching across these tracks, most specifically present on �The Final Harvest,� a solemn piece about her father�s last visit to the allotment he loved so much. It�s suffused with tenderness that extends beyond words. Light and darkness bleed into each other across the music, and moods shift. It�s music that happily stands beyond category, with hints of so many things, but ultimately standing as Alison Cotton music, which might well be all the definition it needs. It will challenge you but also satisfy and move you. What more can you wish from music? Find the artist online. items._cn_summary: 这是Alison Cotton献给2024年末辞世父亲的纪念专辑，以中提琴、手摇风琴、击弦古钢琴与钢琴为核心乐器，并加入鼓、贝斯与合成器拓展声场。多数作品采用一次性即兴录制，笼罩在低沉的持续音之上，营造出跨越时空的静谧与神秘感。评论特别指出《I Am!》以英国自然诗人John Clare的诗句入乐，旋律超凡脱俗；《Sprigs of Heather》从中世纪圣咏般的开篇过渡为钢琴主导的缓降旋律，被视作专辑的珍珠之作；《The Final Harvest》则记录父亲最后一次造访他挚爱的菜园，情感克制而深沉。整体音乐游离于类别之间，光与暗交织，融合民谣、前卫与宗教式的冥想气质，构成一种无法被轻易归类的独特声响。

items.body: After the extra-terrestial explorations of Eventyrferd , the previous album from Norway's Camilla Hole Trio, in which sci-fi synth sounds were married with traditional material, their latest release Langs is rather more earthbound. But the quest to look beyond their own country's folk music continues. Camilla Hole's main instrument being the soprano sax, the influence of jazz is unsurprising and this is evident in the opening track �Springleik,� signifying a tune used to accompany the springleik dance from the west of Norway. Initially Hole takes the melody with Egil Kalman and Knut Kvifte Nesheim providing rhythmic support on double bass and drums respectively, with the overdubbing of Kalman's modular synth and Nesheim's vibraphone adding colour. But characteristically for this trio, in which assigned roles are never clearly defined or adhered to, things soon start to move around, with Kalman taking up the melody on his bass, playing the melody in unison with Hole, while Nesheim opens things out further rhythmically. As the whole piece takes on a much more improvisatory feel, Hole plays the melody one more time as things draw to a close. Langs by Camilla Hole Trio

items._cn_summary: 挪威 Camilla Hole Trio 的新专辑《Langs》延续了上一张《Eventyrferd》中科幻合成器与传统素材结合的探索方向，但整体风格回归更为朴实的土地气息。主奏乐器为高音萨克斯，融合爵士即兴与挪威西部传统民谣旋律，形成跨类型对话。以开场曲为例，曲目源自挪威西部的春之舞（springleik）传统旋律，最初由 Hole 担任主奏，低音提琴与鼓提供节奏支撑，随后叠加模块合成器与颤音琴丰富音色层次。三人组合的最大特点在于角色界限模糊——Kalman 在低音提琴上接过旋律，与 Hole 的萨克斯齐奏，Nesheim 则进一步拓展节奏空间，使整首作品逐渐走向自由即兴。专辑整体在传统民谣素材、爵士即兴自由度和电子音色拓展之间寻找平衡，展现北欧小型爵士团体对民俗与前卫融合路径的持续探索。

items._cn_summary: Habibi Funk 旗下新设子厂牌的首发专辑，选定来自马来西亚的爵士作品作为开篇。文中使用"杰作"一词来形容这张由 Alfonso Soliano 演奏的"Tiga Trombone"长号专辑，暗示其在传统马来音乐语境与爵士语汇之间建立了有意义的连接。长号三重奏的编制在爵士传统中并不常见，结合东南亚地区的音乐资源，可能呈现出有别于欧美主流爵士的声音特质。作为厂牌首张发行，其选材策略本身就带有策展意味——从世界音乐版图中挖掘被忽视的爵士表达。原文章正文极短，仅为新闻摘要性质，缺少对具体音乐语言、演奏技法、专辑结构或文化语境的展开论述，因此虽选题方向契合多元文化与爵士的交叉地带，但实际信息量不足以支撑更深入的判断。

items.body: Review by Greta007 — I normally listen to heavier music but I found that Andreas Vollenwieder is great for getting dogs to settle down. So I bought seven of his albums. This might be the best of them. The music is so many-sided and eclectic that each listen brings something new. Some of my favourites ... though this is an album that needs to be played from start to finish: Morning at Boma Park - upbeat and Afro-jazzyThe title track - great atmosphereIn Doga Gamee - starts out with classical piano and gradually builds with some beautiful motifsPassage to Promise - gentle African music that's a great contrast to the pervious trackJuggler in Obsidian - super tasty flamencoChanson de L'Heure Bleue leading into Czippa and the Ursania Girl - just beautifulThe album isn't so much a "Masterpiece of prog rock" so much as an eclectic masterpiece of world music with prog elements, so four stars.

items._cn_summary: 这张专辑以竖琴为主轴，融合非洲节奏、弗拉门戈、爵士与古典钢琴元素，构建出一幅跨文化的音乐图景。开篇以欢快的非洲爵士基调展开，随后逐渐引入钢琴动机与轻柔的非洲旋律段落，形成情绪上的对比与呼吸感。弗拉门戈段落以质感鲜明的拨弦与节奏呈现，尾声的多首曲目串联则展现出电影配乐般的叙事弧线。整张专辑强调从头至尾的连贯聆听体验，每首曲目都有各自的主题色彩，同时为整体服务。乐评认为其并非典型的前卫摇滚杰作，更接近带有前卫元素的世界音乐融合之作，展现出多面向的折衷主义美学。竖琴演奏者Andreas Vollenweider以非主流的独奏乐器视角切入跨界领域，赋予作品独特的音色基底。

items.body:
Reissue of the debut by A.G. Cook & Danny L Harle’s earliest duo, Dux Content, initially dispensed on Gamsonite, a predecessor of P.C. Music, and teasing out strands of makina, electro-house, bardcore and trap with combo’s of ludic, recombinant suss & sharp sound design that became their calling card.

Scrolling back to what now feels like a distant world - the up-for-grabs edges of early 2010s - ‘Lifestyle’ maps out formative aspects of the two producers, still relatively fresh from music studies at Goldsmiths, and making their mark in a burgeoning “internet music” scene. Of course they’re both now chart-topping songwriters/producers with credits for Charli xcx, Dua Lipa, Oklou, et al, but here they’re positively bubbling over with wild, yet disciplined, fusions of upfront hard dance with jazz, contemporary classical and pop that, with the benefit of hindsight, place them in a contemporaneous cultural slipstream with likes of Cracksmurf/T C F or James Ferraro, and soon-to-be spar, SOPHIE.

‘Lifestyle’ is the sound of two minds scything thru cultures and sounds they grew up with - Harle coming from a family background spanning his Geordie dad, John Harle’s BBC scores and early taste for makina’s stacked melodies - and bonding over a shared love of Captain Beefheart, Archie Sheep, and Tim & Eric, all evident in their grasp of shiny, commercial hooks and complex rhythm wrapped up with daft grin and wink. Shake a wand anywhere and you’ll hit a mad one, from the crazed midi piano house of ‘Voice of an Angel’, thru the jazz-fink of ‘City Break’ and ‘Hero Next Door’, free wheeling jazz trance of ‘Heart of Death’ and pitch bent panpipes of ‘Business Class’.

Cook与Danny L Harle在Goldsmiths求学时期组建的二人组合，《Lifestyle》原由Gamsonite厂牌发行，现由PC Music再版。专辑将硬派舞曲、爵士、当代古典与流行元素以高度凝聚的融合方式呈现，显示出二人日后标志性的声音设计雏形。评论特别指出其中受Captain Beefheart、Archie Shepp及Tim & Eric影响的歪斜幽默，作品横跨迷幻midi钢琴浩室、爵士trance到泛音排箫的奇特组合。虽然两位制作人后来跻身Charli xcx、Dua Lipa等主流合作行列，但此作仍保持着明显的实验倾向与地下精神，置于SOPHIE、James Ferraro的同期文化脉络中阅读更具意义。

items.body:
Produced by Neek and Jabu's Amos Childs (aka O$VMV$M), Manonmars' third album is syrupy suite of smoke-hazed recollections and free associated reflections set to decelerated bumps, sluggish samples and cloudy drones = sturdy biz FFO Young Echo, Massive Attack, Cold Light, Ka, MIKE, King Vision Ultra, Coby Sey.

Manonmars' 2018 debut is one of those albums we still go back to periodically. It's that rare meeting of minds: a space for O$VMV$M to flex their production muscle and a scratchpad for London-based MC, painter and photographer Jack Martyn Richardson to sketch out a distinct vision of England. And His experiences and impressions on 'Entertainment System' still feel chewable. "Goddess on my arm and both our phones got no service," he quips on 'Goddess'. "Acid is lysergic, psychedelic rock is Turkish." His rhymes aren't throwaway, they map out an underground that's very recognisable, shadowed by O$VMV$M's tuff, effective soundscapes - beats that reference trip-hop, ambient music, exotica and '70s movie soundtracks as much as they do US rap. 

On opener 'Flam3throw3r', Mars raps in double-time over shrill horns that blot out any trace of a beat; Neek and Childs sound as if they relish the negative space, adding chic sword swipes to a track that's got little else to do with the Wu Tang Clan. When a lumbering beat kicks in on 'Decathlon', flipping from downtempo to no-tempo in the final act, it sounds as if it's just there to assert O$VMV$M's commitment to slowness - Mars doesn't even seem to notice, rhyming casually but never losing his flow.

Bristol mainstays Franco Franco and Dali de Saint Paul turn up to assist on 'Volcanic Shield', one of the album's most conventional bangers, led by O$VMV$M's skittering Surf Gang-like beats and morse code blips, and cold light's Birthmark lends his voice to 'Infinite', going bar for bar with Mars over Neek and Childs' slackened funk, blaring out like an old tape on a busted in-car audio system. 'Firewater' takes the same approach, leaving Mars to do his best as snares splash across the spectrum with added sax from Brum-based sound artist Lorenzo Prati. "My bitch white, she can scuba dive and ice climb," he spits. "Put the drink down, I wasn't in my right mind." 

It's music that laughs through the tears - what could be more British than that?

items._cn_summary: 这是ManonMars第三张专辑，由制作人Neek和Amos Childs（O$VMV$M组合）操刀。整张专辑以减速节奏、慵懒采样和朦胧嗡鸣为底色，构建出烟雾缭绕般的回忆氛围。制作上融合了trip-hop、环境音乐、exotica、七十年代电影配乐等元素，开场曲在尖锐铜管与留白中展开双倍速说唱，后续曲目从downtempo滑向no-tempo，强调缓慢与负空间的说唱节拍。伦敦MC Jack Martyn Richardson的文字功底扎实，歌词勾勒出一个可辨识的英格兰地下场景，既有冷峻观察也有黑色幽默。客串阵容包括Bristol音乐人Franco Franco、Dali de Saint Paul以及Cold Light的Birthmark，多位声音艺术家加入萨克斯与弦乐点缀。与Young Echo、Massive Attack同属英伦地下实验说唱谱系，但更强调氛围与减速美学，制作层面实验性突出，人声层面则偏向直白的叙事rap。

items.body: Epstein As a writer, researcher, musician, composer, and artist in the public sphere, Melvin Gibbs seems to have been working towards something like How Black Music Took Over the World for while now—a synthesizing work that brings together personal history, polemic, Black music made in and beyond America both under and in spite of a racialized cultural hierarchy, and the heartbreak and joy that come with learning and acknowledging this shared (like it or not) history. How that synthesis enacts itself on paper is one of Gibbs’s particular skills, his melding of register (as he lays out in the Prelude) replays his musical practice. An open reader who lets the book take over will be, I think inarguably, rewarded. One of the key areas that’s under-discussed in literature, as far as I’m aware, which Gibbs both personally and academically goes over in the book is the Gullah-Geechee, the community rooted in the Sea Islands, along the Georgia and Florida coast. In the chapters “Stono’s Children” and “Changing Time With the Times,” Gibbs recounts his discovery of his Gullah heritage, then takes readers on a fascinating journey of the elemental components of rhythm, from ring shout, hambone, swing, and backbeat, to dub. What works pretty well in idea—merging registers, mixing personal memoir with rhythmic analysis—plays out (pardon the unintentional pun) wonderfully on paper. From an extended rhythmic analysis in “Stono’s Children,” Gibbs drops us right into a Harriet Tubman rehearsal. In a later chapter “Can’t Stop,” Gibbs breaks down a specific rhythm he’s dubbed the “lunch table cell,” then demonstrates its use in school lunch ad libs, James Brown’s “Soul Power,” Fela Kuti’s “Shakara,” and Led Zeppelin’s “When the Levee Breaks.” There’s a joy in taking all this in, and the infectious enthusiasm Gibbs seems to take in sharing the rhythms and ideas he’s studied and generated. “The Music of Black Science” demonstrates the linkage from mythos developed through sharing stories to cosmologies that underpin systems of belief, math, science, and artistry. As a somewhat mystical rumination on West African frameworks, and what Gibbs describes as an ontology of Black music. The ensuing pages explore mythologies, fables, and physics through the lens of oral communication and visualization. It’s one of the chapters I’ve dipped back into multiple times, letting myself drift to and fro, which doesn’t seem to contradict Gibb’s intent. However intentional, or not, How Black Music Took Over the World is in conversation with two crucial writers and researchers in this area, Race Music by Guthrie Ramsey and Blacksound by Matthew Morrison. Ramsey’s been in the space for over 30 years building up a compelling and provocative (for me, personally, I’m using this word in terms of “provoking intellectual thought and reflection”) body of work, and Morrison’s Blacksound is the kind of seminal work that hopefully becomes required reading for anyone seeking to understand the acoustical aspects of blackface minstrelsy that became the bedrock of the recording industry. Much like Gibbs’s assembly of evidence showing Black performance and foundational rhythms permeating styles and genres, Morrison demonstrates how Blacksound (re-)centers the ephemeral sonic and performance aesthetics that were capitalized on by early white adopters of vaudeville and dance. While no single author can be expected to cover all aspects of a topic, there are areas Gibbs elides or leaves out of his narrative that are readily picked up in these two—and, yes, many other—books, which an earnest reader is encouraged to also seek out. items._cn_summary: 梅尔文·吉布斯撰写的《黑人音乐如何征服世界》是一部综合性的学术与个人史著作，将个人回忆录与节奏分析相结合，探讨黑人音乐的全球影响力。书中追溯了Gullah-Geechee社区传统，从环舞拍手、哈姆邦、摇摆到回拍与dub，剖析了节奏元素在James Brown、Fela Kuti、Led Zeppelin等不同传统作品中的共通性。《黑人科学的音乐》一章从西非神话出发，通过口述传统与视觉化的视角，探讨黑人音乐本体论与宇宙观、数学、科学的关系。这本书涉及黑人音乐的多重脉络，与Ramsey的《Race Music》及Morrison的《Blacksound》形成对话，为理解黑人音乐的跨文化传播提供了学术框架。

items.body:
Death Is Not The End return to the soul-stir sound of deep south Sacred Harp Singers in 1993 - although it could feasibly be any time since the advent of portable tape recording - in the blessed company of the Union Grove Baptist Church, Ozark, Alabama. Feels just right in this humidity…

The Wiregrass Singers' Dewey Williams began learning the shape-note tradition in his childhood. He studied under Judge Jackson, who authored the landmark 1934 hymnbook The Colored Sacred Harp. In 1971, Williams formally organized The Wiregrass Sacred Harp Singers to preserve the music full-time. This unified troupe began touring nationally and leading workshops, which ultimately launched them onto stages at the Smithsonian and Newport folk festivals up until Williams' passing in 1995 when the group disbanded. The African-American Sacred Harp tradition in the Wiregrass region has steeply declined since the start of the 21st century, due to an aging generation of singers, and today it is largely sustained through archival preservation and occasional multi-book singing meetups.

This raw recording, made at the Union Grove Baptist Church, Ozark in mid-April 1993 finds the group singing from B. F. White’s The Sacred Harp (1844), which together with his brother-in-law William Walker’s Southern Harmony (1835) formed the musical backbone of generations of Southern music and Southern musical styles.
items._genre: Sacred Harp / shape-note singing / American folk / a cappella
items._cn_summary: 专辑记录了阿拉巴马州Ozark联合浸信会教堂的实地录音，由Wiregrass Sacred Harp Singers在1993年演唱B.F. White 1844年《The Sacred Harp》中的曲调。乐评追溯了非洲裔美国人Sacred Harp传统在Wiregrass地区的历史脉络：Dewey Williams自幼学习shape-note演唱，师承1934年《The Colored Sacred Harp》的编辑者Judge Jackson，并于1971年正式组织合唱团，推动全国巡演与工作坊，使这一声乐传统登上Smithsonian与Newport民谣节舞台。录音以原始、未经修饰的现场质感呈现，着重保留教堂声学环境与集体演唱的共鸣。乐评同时指出该传统在21世纪初因歌手老龄化而急剧衰退，目前主要依赖档案保存维持。整张专辑定位为民族音乐学式的田野录音文献，强调传统传承与社区歌唱实践的历史价值。

items.body:
Big room fuel by Tom & Ed Russell’s Overmono, condensing and refining the energy of their ‘Pure Devotion’ megadome events into Pavlovian cues for obedient ravers. OK no bush-beating, it’s torrid stuff that epitomises the schism of music for clubs, dancing, vs corporate-sponsored stages, PR, playlists...

“Sharing a name with the beloved series of live events they launched in 2024, Pure Devotion is Overmono’s most ambitious project to date. It’s the sound of beautiful imperfections, machine malfunctions and happy accidents, harnessed by the unflinching confidence that Overmono - aka brothers Tom and Ed Russell - have gained through years at the vanguard of underground electronic music, and subsequent breakthrough as one of the defining dance music acts of the decade.

Across the 11 tracks, Overmono have pushed their recording process into bold new territories, adopting experimental production techniques that involve synthesisers from the 70s and 80s, an antiquated train announcement speaker, and literally baking a crash cymbal in the oven. There’s a powerful sense of intention and physicality embedded in every choice, which extends to the emotive vocal features from revered British poet John Joseph Holt, close collaborator Kindora, and Paul Institute’s Ruthven It’s an album that chooses emotion over desensitisation. Craft over efficiency. It's a labour of love. Pure Devotion.

What started as a radical reimagining of Overmono’s live show in 2024 evolved into a phenomenon - from headlining Glastonbury’s West Holts to selling out London’s Alexandra Palace and curating Manchester’s Warehouse Project. As Pure Devotion grew onstage in front of tens of thousands of people, its core ideas deepened and crystallised via isolated writing and recordings retreats to Spain and Iceland with nothing but two synths and an FX unit, channeling the momentum into the most life-affirming and groundbreaking music of their career.”

items._cn_summary: Overmono由Tom与Ed Russell兄弟组成，这张专辑是他们同名大型演出系列的录音室延伸。制作上采用七十至八十年代合成器、老式火车站广播喇叭，甚至将镲片放入烤箱烘烤以获取独特音色。十一首曲目贯穿实验性制作手法，邀请英国诗人John Joseph Holt献声，凸显情绪表达而非麻木感。专辑源自2024年现场演出的激进重构，随后在西班牙与冰岛的闭关创作中凝结成型。从Glastonbury到Alexandra Palace的舞台经验被转化为录音室作品，核心动机是放大现场能量中的身体性与意图性，呈现手工质感与情感密度并重的舞曲逻辑。

items.body:
Classy haul of dancehall and street soul-adjacent Zouk from the Caribbean isles, cooked up by Disques Debs, Radio Nova, and Tropical Discoteq programer Émile Omar. Check for the orchestral dates and raggo Créole flow of ‘Mwen inmin’ by Metal Sound; the syrupy sway of Claudy Siar and O’Taïm gems; the low-slung rap of X’Taz.

“Back to the golden nights of zouk clubs, where hip-hop, kompa, zouk and Caribbean grooves ruled the dance-floor. This selection documents a pivotal moment : a time when zouk was still not a fixed genre, but more a place, an atmosphere, somewhere people went to dance. It captures the spirit of an era: its creative effervescence, musical freedom, and the diversity of artists who shaped it. The very concept of “Kaz A Zouk” perfectly encapsulates this idea: a space where all styles could meet.”

items._cn_summary: 这张合辑由Disques Debs、Radio Nova及Tropical Discoteq节目策划人Émile Omar共同梳理，收录1987至1998年间加勒比海群岛的zouk、rap与ragga作品。合辑试图还原zouk尚未定型为固定流派的年代风貌，那时它更像是一个场所与氛围，是人们聚集跳舞的空间。选辑涵盖Metal Sound的管弦编制与克里奥尔语ragga律动、Claudy Siar与O'Taïm的柔缓摇摆曲风，以及X'Taz的低沉rap段落。整体呈现多元风格交汇的创作活跃期，展示了hip-hop、kompa、zouk与加勒比律动在舞池上的融合状态。

items.body:
Breakcore survivor to jungle specialist, Dev/Null continues his 2nd wind with a darker, venomous blast for Naina & Sherelle’s Hooversound

Still beloved for pushing breakcore to its nuttiest, most affective, with 2004’s ‘E-Boyz Revenge: 230 BPM Eternal’ on Violent Turd (sub label of Kid 606’s Tigerbeat 6), Pete Cassin’s long-running project was resurrected with ‘Pocket Selector: A Selection of Micro Jungle’ in 2020 and has since dropped bombs on Future Retro and remixes of DJ Trace and DJ Persuasion in recent years. His ‘Drum Damage’ sustains a mean jungle tekno velocity in four wicked parts, going tight on a darkside flex in ‘Space Rush’ and hard on the 4 with a ‘Brain Bomb’ harking to classic Bizzy B or Tango & Ratty. ‘Come Now’ only escalates the rushy darkside pressure to full-body gurn degrees, where ‘Gateway’ keeps it ticking into the red with gnashing breakbeat gymnastics.
items._cn_summary: Dev/Null的《Drum Damage》是一张丛林与碎核交汇的四曲EP，延续了项目自2020年复活以来的硬派路线。整张作品维持高强度的节奏速度，四首曲目各有侧重：《Space Rush》走紧凑的暗面丛林路线；《Brain Bomb》以四拍底鼓致敬经典黄金时代Jungle制作人如Bizzy B与Tango & Ratty；《Come Now》将暗面压力推至身体极限的狂暴状态；《Gateway》则以复杂的碎拍技巧保持紧张感。整体制作偏向传统碎核与Jungle的速度美学，怀旧感明显但并未带来显著的类型突破，适合偏好高BPM电子硬核节奏的听众。

items.body:
Breezy new age house by an Antipodean artist with illustrious credits beside Michal Hutchence, Bono, Jamiroquai since the ‘80s, evened out with Kuniyuki and 451 remixes...

"Originally emerging from Melbourne’s post-punk and new wave underground in the late 1970s and early 1980s, Gus Till has spent more than four decades navigating a remarkably diverse musical path. From early electronic experimentation with Third Eye alongside Ollie Olsen, through a pivotal role in the formative years of the global psy-trance movement and collaborations with artists including Michael Hutchence, System 7, Manu Dibango, Todd Terry and Bim Sherman, Till’s work has consistently resisted easy categorisation, moving fluidly between ambient music, downtempo, house, trance and psychedelic electronica.

First released on Japan’s Dakini Records in 2006, ‘Rainsong’ captures many of these threads in a single expansive composition. Built around a pulsating bassline, layered live percussion and soaring vocal elements, the track sits comfortably between the dancefloor and more immersive listening environments. Unfolding patiently across nearly thirteen minutes, it combines hypnotic rhythmic momentum with a rich sense of atmosphere and musicality.

For the B-side, Kuniyuki Takahashi offers a distinct reinterpretation of the original. His remix gradually unfolds from a patient introduction into a deep and richly textured exploration of the track’s core themes. Subtle spatial processing, nuanced arrangement shifts and his unmistakable sense of atmosphere transform the source material while preserving its emotional core."
items._genre: new age house / ambient / downtempo / electronic
items._cn_summary: 澳大利亚电子音乐人Gus Till的《Rainsong》以新纪元浩室为底色，融合环境音乐与慢拍电子的质感。主曲长近十三分钟，构建在脉动低音线与多层现场打击乐之上，加入人声元素营造沉浸氛围，介于舞池实用性与聆听深度之间。B面收录日本制作人Kuniyuki Takahashi的混音版本，从安静的引子逐步展开，以细腻的空间处理与编排层次重新解构原作情绪内核，同时保留原始的情感表达。Till的音乐生涯跨越四十余年，从墨尔本后朋克与新浪潮地下场景出发，经历迷幻trance运动早期，与多位国际音乐人合作过，作品脉络横跨ambient、house、trance与psychedelic electronica等多种领域。《Rainsong》最初于2006年在日本Dakini Records发行，此次再版附带451的混音作为新版附加内容。整体呈现为融合多元素的浩室电子长篇作品，适合深夜聆听场景。

On the leather loafer heels of ‘Digging Central Asia: Musical Archeology Along The Silk Road’, collector and archivist qorakitobchi aka Anvar Kalandarov returns to a region known as historic, transcontinental crossroads, at a point when it transitioned from Soviet rule to relative independence
items.body:
Anyone charmed by Anvar Kalandarov’s Silk Road mixes will be all over this return ticket to Central Asian Synthesisers, spotlighting a general blindspot of ’80s-‘90s Uzbek & Tajik disco for Western ears...

On the leather loafer heels of ‘Digging Central Asia: Musical Archeology Along The Silk Road’, collector and archivist qorakitobchi aka Anvar Kalandarov returns to a region known as historic, transcontinental crossroads, at a point when it transitioned from Soviet rule to relative independence. The music reflects its Central Asian provenance with a blend of Western disco, as filtered via Soviet modernity, inflected with a melodic sweetness that our untrained ears affiliate with Chinese pop, and film and pop music of Pakistan and the subcontinent, or in other words; a rarified pleasure for those with a sweet tooth for disco frivolity.

Kalandarov and Death Is Not the End’s exquisite ear for enduring tunes is fully locked in across both sides. The first gets into gear with cooing divas strapped to vestiges of late ‘70s disco, flush with microtonal synth plumes, before steadily edging into ’80s disco pomp, proper, and a big old Euro-house belter. The other side follows into more surprising, off-road oddities ranging from a bit of spiky new wave synth funk to racier Eurasian NRG and flashdance panache, paving the way to a big romantic ballad and a closing starburst of peak time Euro-house to seal the deal.

items._cn_summary: 这张专辑由档案收集者Anvar Kalandarov与Death Is Not the End合作，聚焦上世纪八九十年代乌兹别克斯坦与塔吉克斯坦的迪斯科音乐，这些作品对西方听众而言长期处于盲区。音乐呈现苏联现代主义影响下的西方迪斯科风格，旋律中带有与中文流行、巴基斯坦及南亚电影音乐相近的甜美感。专辑分A面与B面：A面从七十年代末迪斯科余韵出发，经由八十年代迪斯科壮丽段落，最终走向Euro-house节拍；B面则更为出人意料，涵盖新潮合成器放克、欧亚NRG舞曲、Flashdance式炫技、抒情慢歌与巅峰Euro-house等多元路数。整体上是一次横跨中亚与苏联后期的声音考古，将地方流行与跨国俱乐部文化编织在一起。

items.excerpt: 今年、生誕100周年をむかえたマイルス・デイヴィス。マイルスについて書かれた本が数多く世に出たけれど、これほどまでに彼の音楽の中身にフォーカスされたものは他にない。アルバムごとの演奏を事細かに分析し、マイルスの即興演奏への向き合い方の変容を捉えることで、ジャズミュージシャンとしてどのように新しいものを生み出そうとしていたのかが浮き彫りになる。また、ライヴの映像での仕草やアルバムとのセットリストの違いなど音の外側にも目を向け、彼の思考に迫ろうとしているのが面白い。やや音楽に精通した人向けの内容ではあるものの、マイルスの音源を聴きながら楽しんでほしい一冊である。

items._cn_summary: 这是一本关于爵士巨匠迈尔斯·戴维斯的学术研究著作，适逢其诞辰100周年出版。书中逐张专辑深入分析迈尔斯的即兴演奏手法演变，追踪他从传统爵士向融合爵士、电子爵士不断突破的创作轨迹。除录音分析外，作者还关注现场影像中的肢体语言与曲目编排差异，试图从声音内外双重视角还原这位音乐家的思考方式。全书以乐谱与即兴结构分析为核心，虽偏向具备一定音乐素养的读者，但配合迈尔斯本人的原始录音阅读，能让人更清晰地理解他如何在不同阶段重新定义爵士乐的可能性。

items.body:
According to its founder, Eugene Rodriguez, who also sings and plays on the record, Los Cenzontles is a �musical group and non-profit organization, which I founded over thirty years ago.�  As he continues in the album�s liner notes, the group �has a long history of producing projects exploring Mexico�s deep roots and our connections with various traditions that, so far, have included Irish, Louisiana Creole, Cuban, American cowboy, classical, pop, rock, and blues�, the latest of which is
Adios Ke Aloha: Waves of the Same Sea
. Los Cenzontles translates to the mockingbird, or, from its Aztec root word, the bird of four hundred voices. This is a fitting name for the range of musical diversity represented here.
With songs sung in Spanish, Hawaiian, and English, the concept traces back to the legacy of Mexican cowboys who travelled from California to the Hawaiian Islands to wrangle the long-horned cattle introduced there in the nineteenth century. They also brought the guitar. The 16 tracks feature old Hawaiian songs with new Spanish lyrics, old Mexican songs with new Hawaiian lyrics, new compositions, and traditional Americana. Yet it is an entirely cohesive musical package held together by dense arrangements of ukuleles, guitars, Mexican harp, and accordion.
Sonny Lim & David Hidalgo
Besides their distinctive voices, the headline artists Taj Mahal and David Hidalgo provide the gravitas and musicianship that their long and distinguished careers have earned. According to the liner notes, they were the catalysts behind the project and facilitated the choice of songs, arrangements, and played a range of instruments. On vocals they are joined by Hawaiian natives Gary Haleamau, Sheldeen Haleamau, Sonny Lim, and long-time Cenzontles member Fabiola Trujillo.
Deportee
To give a taste of the sessions, included before the traditional �Fishin� Blues� is Taj Mahal teaching the musicians how to play it. Sung by David Hildalgo,  the lovely �A Matter of Time� comes from the 1984 album
Will the Wolf Survive
by his most famous project, Los Lobos. Another standout for me, �Navegar� features a slack string guitar solo reminiscent of Duane Eddie and one of many tasty lap steel turns by Sonny Lim. Their interpretation of Woody Guthrie's �Deportee� moves into social commentary, highlighting the cruel realities of being a migrant worker in America.
Vaquero Paniolo
Recorded over five days, mostly live in one room at the Los Cenzontles headquarters in San Pablo, California, including the talents of some of their academy�s students, the recording has real spontaneity to it. Arrangements are stretched by improvisations, sometimes by several different instruments on a single tune. The project also represents a great spirit of cooperation and diversity of language, culture, age, and gender. It includes the inputs of musical legends, seasoned pros, and amateurs. The wonderfully rich and often stereotyped musical cultures of both Mexico and Hawaii are represented here with the authenticity of lived experience.
Adios Ke Aloha: Waves of the Same Sea
is a worthy addition to Los Cenzontles� important work. Quoting Rodriguez again, �Culture is a fabric within which we are all woven.�

items.body: Those of us who have been digging into Analog Africa�s increasingly formidable releases over the last two decades are well aware of the massive amount of raw, vodun-based Sato and Sakpata-derived funk the label has issued by Benin�s most prolific 1970s-era band, the Orchestre Poly-Ritmo. AA has dropped no fewer than 3 compilations of their heaviest material, as well as a reissue of the band�s first LP, in an effort to give them the international status they deserve. That being said, what might be different about this collection of their music? And who is Antoine Dougb�? Antoine Dougb� et L'Orchestre Poly-Rythmo De Cotonou 1977 - 1982 (Analog Africa No.44) by Analog Africa As it turns out, Dougb� was a song-conjurer whose mode of musical transfer was slapping his legs in a rhythm known as Cavacha, a groove created by drummer Belobi Meridjo, who was inspired by a train cadence that he worked into a pattern that ultimately spread like a 21st century California wildfire throughout Congolese pop music in the mid-1970s. Dougb�, known as the �Devil�s Prime Minister,� was also a practitioner of vodun who inspired fear in any musician he felt was unsuited to play his music, which is how he landed on working exclusively Poly-Ritmo, as he felt they could nail what he wanted in ways other bands couldn�t. His recording career was brief - 3 albums and a few singles - but as this collection shows, it was potent. Antoine Dougb� et L'Orchestre Poly-Rythmo De Cotonou 1977 - 1982 (Analog Africa No.44) by Analog Africa Because of the era from which this music dates, it�s not surprising that the recording and instrument tones have changed - the guitars have a plastic sheen and synthesizers appear- even if the music remains rooted in the 1970s. Perhaps the influence of the Cuban son is more apparent here than on other Poly-Ritmo collections, especially in the collection�s initial offerings. And yes, Congolese rumba, then shaking all of sub-Saharan Africa to its knees, is present too. �Ma Won Min Towe Leo� is one example. Opening with a bed of synthesizers, the shimmering guitars, tinny, seemingly squeezed dry by the 80s themselves, lock in over relentless high-hat-focused grooves. The guitars finally start firing in different directions midway through, before that synth weaves back in, forming a bed underneath it all. Antoine Dougb� et L'Orchestre Poly-Rythmo De Cotonou 1977 - 1982 (Analog Africa No.44) by Analog Africa �We Tayi Sin Assi Tche� is much more overtly Cuban. With its insistent cowbell, classic, nasal vocal call and response, and tight, repeated guitar figures, its debt to mid-twentieth century Afro-Cuban sons is transparent. Another track, �Djomido Ma Dougbe Tche� rides a groove reminiscent of 70�s-era Franco classic �Liberte.� The pulse is relentless, and the guitar solo repeats a tight repetition of a few notes, driving listeners to ecstasy all the while. However, none of this music is a mere copy of its influences; rather, like so much potent pop coming from the continent at the time, it is a swirl of major influences rendered by local rhythms and vocal phrasing to give it specific identity, in this case, to Benin. Dougb�s musical role on this collection is a bit murky. One of his three albums has a photo of him, fully mic�d behind a collection of hand drums, so perhaps he served as a percussionist/vocalist; this release never explains. He wasn�t a songwriter in the traditional sense. It seems he was more of an instigator and arranger, but his thumbprint was apparently heavy enough to warrant his name on the records he was involved with. Whatever the case, in his brief run as a recording artist, he and Poly-Ritmo produced a handful of driving, Cavacha-inspired grooves that can still wear holes in club floors. Further reading: Petrona Mart�nez - Ancestras (Review) Gnonnas Pedro & His Dadjes - Roi De L'Agbadja Moderne 1974-1983 (Review)

items._cn_summary: Analog Africa厂牌推出的这张贝宁乐队Poly-Rythmo与歌手Antoine Dougbé的合作合集，收录1977至1982年间的录音。Dougbé以拍击大腿打出Cavacha节奏著称，配合乐队融合巫毒传统节奏、古巴son刚果伦巴的律动，形成跨大西洋与跨非洲的混合声响。乐评指出作品受古巴影响明显，吉他带有塑料质感音色，合成器铺陈底床，高帽节奏密集推进。"Ma Won Min Towe Leo"以合成器开篇，吉他在中段分裂对位；"We Tayi Sin Assi Tche"则更直接呈现古巴风味，铿锵牛铃与鼻音呼应对唱构成经典结构。作为贝宁最繁忙的七十年代乐队的合集，聚焦Dougbé短暂的录音生涯，展示了非洲流行音乐在那个时代如何吸纳同时期的拉丁元素。

items.body:
Sometime in 1986, perhaps in a Paris caf�, Dominique Cravic, a singer, guitarist, and musical archivist, met Robert Crumb, an underground cartoonist, banjo and mandolin player, and jug-band aficionado. Over a few glasses of marc, to continue to speculate, they conjured up the idea for Les Primitifs du futur.  Since then, they have recorded an impossible-to-categorize series of albums, with cover illustrations by Crumb, of which Les Crimes du Mussette is the fifth.
Weird and wonderful, it sounds like they rooted through an attic full of 78 RPM records, scribbled down some arrangements, and then played them on a collection of instruments they found in another attic, including accordion, sax, xylophone, clarinet, banjo, ukulele, theremin, Hawaiian guitar, bagpipe chanter (I�m guessing here), and musical saw.
Ne tirez pas sur le pianiste (excerpt)
The 27 short tracks are mostly voiced by Cravic, who talk-sings in the manner of an everyman Maurice Chevalier. He is often accompanied by the accordion, a customary instrument in the bal-musette style that remains a strong element of the eclectic range of styles they have managed to synthesize. They also include ragtime, jug, French chanson, and, to my ears, skiffle,  just to get the list started.
Ukulele Lady (excerpt)
The liner notes point out that �Les Crimes du Musette is also a gold mine for scholars, a veritable treasure trove.� Exploring the treasures is beyond my scope here, as each tune has a long history. A highlight for me is the humorous �Ukulele Lady� from 1925, which first delighted me on Arlo Guthrie�s 1971 album
Hobo�s Lullaby
. The song has also been covered by Bing Crosby, Peter Sellers, and Bette Midler.
N'oublie pas Gr�co (excerpt)
A more serious item is �N�oublie pas Gr�co� (Don�t Forget Gr�co�)  is a tribute to the legendary chanteuse and heroine of the French Resistance, Juliette Gr�co, who died in 2020. You will also hear old chestnuts like �Fum�e aux yeux� (�Smoke Gets in Your Eyes�),  �Boude pas� (�Take Five�), and �Prive d�amour� (�As Time Goes By�).
This record is a curiosity, but it is performed by serious musicians with total commitment. In this, I was reminded of the similarly indefinable Dan Hicks & the Hot Licks. Long-forgotten music and abandoned styles are given new animation with obvious enthusiasm and care. Speaking about himself and his collaborators, many of whom are in their seventies, Dominique Cravic says, �The young have fire, but we have light.� In its own little corner,
Les Crimes du Musette
shines bright.

Vanishment
(Review)

Genuine Negro Jig

items.body: Kr�ta , the latest release on Norway's Taragot label, features a Swede and two Norwegians playing interpretations of mainly traditional tunes from their respective countries. Fiddler Mats Ed�n has long been involved in Swedish folk music, as a player, composer and teacher, and in the process exploring and integrating different musical styles and approaches. Tellef Kvifte was in the pioneering Norwegian crossover band Slinkombas in the 1970s and has continued to play a central role in Norwegian folk music, both as a musician and an academic. Most often heard playing the sj�fl�yte , more widely known as a recorder, Kvifte has employed other instruments from outside the Norwegian tradition, in particular the saxophone and bagpipes. His son Knut Kvifte Nesheim , a drummer and composer, has also shown a determination to blur the lines between different musical genres, both in his solo and group projects. Kr�ta by Ed�n/Kvifte/Nesheim trio It comes as no surprise then to find this trio offering a far from conventional take on the tunes they have chosen. While dance tunes may be the source of most of the material here, this feels more akin to chamber music; not that it is remotely classical in style, but in the sense it conveys of three players engrossed in a musically intimate conversation. This is not a performance appropriate for accompanying dancers but might instead be seen as an exploration of hidden possibilities of meaning in the music. In so doing it reveals some of its underlying mystery, including, perhaps, a darker side. Just as in an Ibsen play, where the surface bonhomie, jollity and social nicety can be hiding something more sinister, in Scandinavian dance music there are at times hints of a troublesome undercurrent below the surface. So the decision to open proceedings with �Fossgrimen,� a fiddle tune from Norway's Setesdal valley, is perhaps significant. A fossgrimen is a mythical creature, a kind of water-sprite living in waterfalls from whom fiddle-players were considered to have learned their skills and for that were not universally welcomed, with the fiddle considered to be the devil's instrument. Kr�ta by Ed�n/Kvifte/Nesheim trio Tellef Kvifte takes the lead melody on most tracks but on the Swedish �Polska from Per Myhr,� having played a repeated introductory riff on the sj�fl�yte, with Mats Ed�n providing an amorphous textural accompaniment below and Nesheim adding some quiet tinkling, it's Ed�n who introduces the tune on the fiddle with Kvifte proceeding to play in unison. It's a short track and almost as soon as it gets going things start to fragment and everything grind to a halt.
items.label: Taragot
items._genre: Scandinavian folk / chamber improvisation / world fusion
items._cn_summary: 这是一张由瑞典小提琴家与两位挪威音乐家组成的三重奏专辑，由挪威小型厂牌Taragot发行。三位演奏者均深耕北欧民间音乐领域，乐评将其演奏定位为对传统舞曲的非常规诠释，更接近室内乐式的亲密对话——三位乐手围绕旋律即兴展开层层解构与重组。选曲虽多源自传统舞曲素材，但专辑刻意剥离了舞蹈伴奏功能，转而挖掘旋律中隐藏的暗流与深层含义。乐评以易卜生戏剧为喻，暗示北欧舞曲表层欢愉之下常有不祥潜流，开篇选用的挪威塞特斯达尔谷地小提琴曲便是这一隐喻的载体。演奏中长笛、小提琴与打击乐之间不断进行旋律领奏、齐奏与碎片化瓦解的交替，呈现出对民间素材的实验性重新审视。

items.body: Editor's note: When this set of recordings came to me, I was at a loss as to how to share it. It's not music, in any traditional sense (although there is some freestyle rapping), and a 'review' of such an artifact of reality seems superfluous to the content. Instead, I asked sound recordist Ian Brennan if I could simply use his own brief commentary and the recordings he made on the street in Chicago. Twenty-five people afflicted by gun violence participated, many from the very block we�d setup on. Many neighbors were pulled-in spontaneously. Almost every one in the community had been impacted by violence somehow� both on the receiving and the inflicting end, and many both. One woman had just come from a memorial service, another was on her way. That�s how far-reaching the violence. Almost no one went untouched. The Forgotten Parts by Chicago Gunfire Survivors By chance, we convened on the day that Trump ordered the deployment of the National Guard to the city. The recording took place on the front porch of the leader's ninety-four-year-old grandmother's house�right in the heart of the ��hood,� beneath the Midway Airport�s landing path. A pair of stray pitfalls stalked the block. But the grandmother warned not of gunshots, but the mosquitoes in her yard. The Forgotten Parts by Chicago Gunfire Survivors We were in a section of town that one man defined as �the forgotten parts.� Just a short jaunt from the designer clothes shops and posh hotels of the city�s Magnificent Mile, the Southside spawned such legendary Blues artists as Muddy Waters, Willie Dixon, and Howlin� Wolf. Jazz musicians like Lionel Hampton and even Benny Goodman, hailed from nearby. The Forgotten Parts by Chicago Gunfire Survivors The participants ranged in age from seventeen to sixty-seven, but the pattern held true. The person who�d asserted �you�ll really want to hear my story,� was the least compelling. The reluctant, the most moving. One elder�s tough facade broke down as she shared how she�d lost both her sons. She tearfully apologized, �I�m sorry. I�m sorry. I�m sorry.� But she had nothing to be sorry for. Society is the one that owes the apology� for the staggering statistical inequities of which no reasonable defense can be made. The Forgotten Parts by Chicago Gunfire Survivors Editor's note: The full set of recordings are available on Bandcamp. Any profits from this project will be donated to Cure Violence Global , who states that their mission is "advancing an evidence-based health approach to end violence globally." When I asked him about the background sounds, producer Ian Brennan added, "No music is added. It�s all sounds from the source environment. I also ran loops/drones on a different track in the background as they spoke, and when they ended up being incidentally/somewhat magically/eerily synchronous, that is what was used for a few pieces with 'accompaniment' like some of the rap freestyles."
items._genre: field recording / spoken word / documentary / soundscape
items._cn_summary: 这张专辑并非传统意义上的音乐作品，而是由录音师Ian Brennan在芝加哥街头实地录制的声响档案。二十五位遭受枪支暴力影响的社区居民参与其中，从十七岁到六十七岁，讲述了各自与暴力相关的经历。录制地点位于一位九十四岁祖母家的前廊，正值特朗普下令国民警卫队进驻芝加哥的当天。录音中一位母亲因失去两个儿子而崩溃道歉，展现出枪支暴力对普通社区的深层创伤。整张专辑以纯粹的田野录音和环境声为核心，包含少量自由说唱但未添加任何音乐元素。项目收益将捐给反暴力组织。这是一件介于声音艺术与社会纪实之间的实验性作品，挑战了传统听音乐的方式，将听者的注意力引向那些被遗忘的角落。

items.body:
Trading rave for augmented rock, Charli XCX follows the epochal 'brat' with an album that gets ahead of the curve, exciting its indie sleaze and Copenhagen-wave pop backdrop with casual memories from her last two years on the cultural front line.

Before you even try to talk about the music itself, you've gotta get past the cover: a black-and-white photograph of Martin Scorsese, John Cale and Marc Jacobs. There were easier references Aitchison could have made, auteurs who her sizeable audience could have connected to without having to scrape Wikipedia, but it's a statement. When 'brat' blew up - probably beyond even her team's expectations - Aitcherson suddenly found herself on an A-list she'd only grazed in the past. She'd had critical success before, but this was universal acclaim paired with commercial power - she even had the summer of 2024 named after the album. And since then she's been cautiously ubiquitous, acting in a handful of odd indie films, penning the soundtrack to Emerald Fennell's blockbuster 'Wuthering Heights' and producing 'The Moment', a film loosely based on her 'brat' touring experiences. She understands that her place in the pop canon is basically defined by her good taste; if Taylor Swift represents capital itself - the (white) product of the American system, the daughter of a stockbroker and a marketing exec - Aitchison represents the very edge of the mainstream. It's no surprise that she's allying with notorious rebels like Cale, when you think about it.

Of course, 'Music, Fashion, Film' isn't anywhere near as daring as 'The Marble Index' or 'Desertshore', but it is daring all the same. Aitchison follows the club hedonism of 'brat', an album that reasonably could have been released at any time in the last decade, with one that pre-empts a sea change before it's really taken hold. If you've been looking carefully, you'll have noticed that the iron grip electronic music has had on pop has started to loosen; for the first time in decades rock seems to be attractive to young audiences again. Of course, the writing's been on the wall. And then there's the knotty business of AI - it's far more complicated to clone a sloppy indie band than it is to replicate pristine club sounds. Aitchison doesn't throw the baby out with the bath water here - the album is still propped up by A.G. Cook's brushed aluminium productions - but as she says on opener 'Rock Music': "I think the dancefloor is dead / So now we're making rock music."

The aesthetic touch stone here is Daft Punk, though. Aitchison's voice, contorted as she recounts her recent experiences, sounds like it's a bright analogue synth away from 'Human After All'. But the stuttering guitars - already a meme thanks to 'Rock Music' - are refreshingly modish. 'Card Declined' is delivered with the cocaine-assisted sneer of Manhattan's "indie sleaze" scene, while early highlight 'Camera' is genuinely vulnerable ("it makes me want to throw my life away," she says about being on film), with soaring riffs that plant New Order in Paris. With its gloomy cellos and distorted wails, 'I'm Afraid' is probably the album's most uncompromising track (certainly its least "pop"), but the stand-out for us is the finale, when David Cronenberg cuts in with a monologue over woozy organs. "They are dead, they are gone / no-one lasts for ever," he repeats until the album grinds to a halt.

items._genre: indie sleaze / copenhagen-wave pop / electronic rock
items._cn_summary: 在《brat》取得现象级成功后，Charli XCX以《Music, Fashion, Film》转向更前瞻的领域。专辑封面选用Martin Scorsese、John Cale与Marc Jacobs的黑白合影，暗示她对自身文化资本的重塑——从主流的边缘抵达一个具有话语权的位置。音乐上，A.G. Cook的制作依然贯穿始终，但引入了失谐吉他与模拟合成器质感，向Daft Punk《Human After All》致敬。Charli认为电子音乐对流行的统治正在松动，摇滚重新吸引年轻听众，AI也更难复制粗糙的独立乐队质感。作品如《Card Declined》带有曼哈顿独立sleaze的鼻音嘲讽，《Camera》则呈现罕见的脆弱时刻。整体上，这张专辑是俱乐部享乐主义之后的转向，融合了独立摇滚美学与流行敏锐度。

items.body:
SYEYL Introduces New Fuzzy Euphoric Electronica EP With 'limer' Via EELF Records

11 August 2026

Hrithik Arora aka SYEYL claims to have been "losing touch with his own artistic voice" before he found his way back with the upcoming EP 'Music Is The Answer', moving away from composing for function and bookings to reconnect with an emotive instinct. The choice pays off as the New Delhi-based artist manages to create focused and cohesive emotional worlds on the 5-track EP, especially unburdened by the need to include an excess of ideas in order to impress on the lead single 'limer'.

Shortened from the word "limerence", the track accordingly packs that sentimental dancefloor moment euphoria seen in the works of the likes of Bicep, Tom VR and some Four Tet. Simple rhythms of pristine digital textures syncopate against each other to create a sense of movement and rhythmic and harmonic ambience atop the four-to-the-floor groove, while the music video's early digital-camera aesthetic rounds out the nostalgic undercurrent in the music.

Watch the music video below and head to SYEYL's artist profile for more.

items._cn_summary: 印度新德里制作人SYEYL通过EELF Records厂牌发行五曲EP《Music Is The Answer》，主打单曲《limer》取自"limerence"一词的缩写，承载着抒情舞池的欣快感。作品中干净的数字音色纹理以切分方式彼此交织，在四拍底鼓节奏之上构建出动态的节奏与和声氛围，呼应了Bicep、Tom VR乃至部分Four Tet作品的情感走向。音乐录影带采用早期数码相机美学，与音乐中的怀旧暗流形成呼应。艺术家在创作中尝试从功能性配乐与商业预约中抽离，重新回归情感本能的驱动，使五首曲目形成了聚焦且连贯的情绪世界。

items.body: Three Sunsets Over MarsfieldLP, Album, Limited EditionFaraway Press – FARAWAY PRESS 18UK2010Three Sunsets Over MarsfieldLP, Album, Limited Edition, SlipcaseFaraway Press – FARAWAY PRESS 18UK2013 Flavour text written by Brendan Walls for the press release:"Shortly after the Second World War, a medical facility for returned soldiers was built in the small town of Marsfield.The patients were in some way incapacitated by that great and monstrous war; some missing limbs, some deafened or blinded by explosions, others driven out of their senses.A few muttered old military secrets, a few sang long-forgotten ballads, a few built small ships inside milk bottles; others walked the corridors and grounds, scanning every dark corner for an unseen but ever present enemy.It was not an unhappy place; there was a sense of deep friendship amongst the patients, bound as they were by the collective hell of battle. One of the most popular amongst the men was Lieutenant Wilson. He was no more than a Lance Corporal but earned the nickname Lieutenant during his stay at the home. Wilson had the remarkable ability to receive radio signals through the metal plate in his head. He would touch a metal window frame or steel bed head, incline his head at oblique angles, open his mouth and a sort of popping static would emanate from within his dark mouth. Subtle manipulations of his jaw, the inclination of his head or his physical location in the room would alter the signals he received.As it happened he was the longest surviving member of the facility. When it was decommissioned in 2000, he was to be moved to a neighbouring hospital to see out his final days. Wilson resolutely refused to be moved. Barricading himself in his room, he declined food, water and medical attention until he was eventually moved to the west wing of the home and cared for by a rotation of staff members from the nearby hospital. He finally passed away in the later months of 2002 when this album was recorded."Recording info supplied in newsletter from Faraway Press.
items._cn_summary: 这张专辑以二战退伍军人疗养院为叙事背景，通过虚构的"Wilson中尉"形象——一位头部嵌入金属板、能通过金属接收无线电信号的伤兵——构建出一段关于孤独、坚守与消逝的听觉叙事。专辑于2002年Wilson去世时录制，文本本身即作为作品概念框架，暗示其声音可能围绕无线电静电、金属共振、环境声响与极简氛围展开。Faraway Press作为英国小型独立厂牌发行限量版实体唱片，呈现概念艺术与声音探索相结合的创作路径。其价值在于将历史创伤叙事转化为声音素材的概念构思，而非传统音乐结构。适合对实验声响、概念专辑与氛围音乐感兴趣的听众。

items.body:
2026 Re-press of "Spaghetti Circus" by Still Going on DFA Records.

"Still Going arrived on the scene with “Still Going Theme,” a seductive layering of deep, creeping bass, swelling synths and tinkling pianos atop a disco pulse. Along with its hypnotic flipside, “On and On,” the single captivated listeners with its anthemic energy and quickly became a dance floor staple. With the release of “Spaghetti Circus,” Olivier “Liv” Spencer and Eric “Dunks” Duncan build on their reputation for creating compelling dance music for compulsive listening.

This record is two years in the making, time the duo spent churning out a steady stream of remixes for an impressive roster of musicians, including The Presets, !!!, Crazy P, Force of Nature, Doves and Low Motion Disco. They've also been busy with their respective DJ projects – Dunks with the infamous duo Rub-N-Tug and Liv as one half of dance favorites House of House. On the heels of these numerous endeavors, Still Going have managed to return with a stellar new release.

“Spaghetti Circus,” the title track, pairs rubbery bass with trance-inducing waves of swooning, orchestral keys and dramatic piano. The B-Side, “Untitled Love,” changes the mood, settling comfortably into a space-ious, swaggering mid-tempo groove. Set against these lush backdrops are vocals from Reggie Watts, a singer whose performances both live and on record have established him as an immense talent. Watt’s urgent, rough-hewn voice serves to propel the driving rhythm of “Spaghetti Circus,” while on “Untitled Love,” his soulfully smooth vocals anchor the track’s languid pace.

Other featured performances on this long-awaited 12” are sure to generate even more enthusiasm for its release. Andrew Raposo, formerly of Hercules & Love Affair and now of Jessica 6, Midnight Magic and Tippy Toes, plays bass on both songs. Jason Rabe of Los Angeles-based band The VLA contributes lead guitar to “Spaghetti Circus” And Tim Lee, founder of noted electronic label Tummy Touch Records, plays the Rhodes on “Untitled Love.” "
items._cn_summary: Still Going 组合由 Liv Spencer 与 Eric Duncan 组成，在 DFA Records 厂牌发行了《Spaghetti Circus》EP，2026 年重新压制发行。主体曲目以弹性贝斯线为骨架，交织迷幻合成器波浪、戏剧性钢琴与管弦乐式键盘音色，营造出催眠式的舞曲律动。另一首作品则转向更宽松慵懒的中速律动，融合太空感的律动层次。Reggie Watts 担任两曲人声贡献，前者以粗粝紧迫的声音推动节奏，后者以灵魂化的平滑声线稳住松散的结构。Andrew Raposo 演奏贝斯，Jason Rabe 贡献主音吉他，Tim Lee 负责 Rhodes 电钢琴演奏。整体制作偏向俱乐部舞曲美学，与实验电子或当代即兴路线距离较大，但其混搭编制与跨界合作呈现出一定趣味。

items.body:
The musical partnership between Kalaniemi and Alakotila has thrived over a remarkable 35 years, long enough to the Finnish pair to develop a stunning intimacy and telepathy. Kalaniemi is a lovingly melodic accordion player, with a sharp ear for a good tune, building each one into a thing of great beauty, while pianist Alakotila not only supports her but adds enough of his own to help transform every piece into a glistening gem.
There�s a sense of calmness to the work here, a long, sweet exhalation between two instrumentalists who are deep enough in sync to allow seamless improvisation beyond any written score and carry the listeners along with them. For much of the album, it�s just the pair of them, including Kalaniemi�s wordless voice, as on the opener, the tradional �Lyck�nskan.� She does charmingly sing lyrics on the title track, written by Lasse M�rtenson, with the sound there neatly and sparingly expanded with the addition of a string quartet.
Morgondimma
There are several original pieces alongside the tradition, with Kalaniemi�s �Hambo Vid F�bodan� a real standout, and it�s perhaps inevitable on any disc featuring accordion that a Piazzolla tune should be included, brings its own shadows to the whole (�Oblivion�). And, this being Finland, a tango is almost obligatory, in this case Alakotila�s �Tango Berlin.�
Tango Berlin
There�s a gentle, dreamlike quality to so much of this, flowing and mellifluous. The pieces aren�t an arena for showy virtuosity. Instead, the two musicians serve the tune, exploring and genuinely enjoying their performances.
It won�t shake the earth, but it makes for some true listening beauty.

items._cn_summary: 这是一张由芬兰手风琴演奏家Maria Kalaniemi与钢琴家Timo Alakotila合作的双人专辑，两人历经三十五年的音乐搭档关系形成了高度默契的即兴对话。专辑以传统曲目为主轴，间或融入原创作品，包括一首皮亚佐拉的探戈与一首芬兰式探戈，整体氛围宁静流畅，注重旋律的内在美感而非炫技表演。Kalaniemi的无词人声与Alakotila的钢琴编织出如梦似幻的质感，弦乐四重奏在标题曲中适度扩展了音色层次。两位音乐家以服务旋律为前提，深入探索曲调本身的情感空间，呈现出一种温柔而绵长的听觉体验。

items.body: Review by XixoTheRock — After Roger Waters released "The dark side of the moon redux" in 2023, I couldn't help but noticehow one of the spoken word sections, specifically the one on the track "Speak to me (redux)",consists of the lyrics of. "Free four", but narrated inna grim, almost deathly way...this pinpointsto me how brilliant "Free four" actually is, the 1972 track released as a single tricks our minds inhow despite having upbeat, catchy, fun and relatively simple and silly instrumentation, that justacts as a veil to distract from the anxious, nihilistic and somber lyrics of the track.There really is no need to analyze the musicianship, the production (specially in remasteredversions, James Guthrie captures the Floyd essence with a flick of the wrist) or any of that, it'sPink Floyd, we cannot expect any less than high quality from them...so what I'll say is that thissingle shines just by how absurd the contrast is, it's brilliant, you can sing or hum the melodieswith ease and find yourself enjoying a nice pop song, and then at night find yourself questioningwhat you are even doing in life with it's lyrics, trying to fathom just how futile this all is...atfirst I didn't understand the single, now I do, it's a clever twist on what upbeat music should belike.Then we have "The gold it's in the...", I can't say much about the track, it's fun and catchy,compared to anything else Floyd made it's a piece of cake and really doesn't shine all that much,yet it's still enjoyable!It's a fun single, does a good job and has a clever twist, it can be anyone's cup of tea, I'll rateit 3/5 stars, mainly because the songs are fun but not that special compared to other art rock fromthat era, it's really good! And when you put it in context (soundtrack for the film "La Vall�e") youcan understand why it is the way it is.
items._genre: psychedelic rock / space rock / art rock
items._cn_summary: 这张1972年发行的单曲收录了Pink Floyd为电影《La Vallée》创作的配乐作品。评论者认为《Free Four》是这张单曲的核心亮点：表面上拥有朗朗上口的旋律和明快的编曲，内里却包裹着虚无主义和存在焦虑的歌词，这种反差构成了其艺术价值。评论者将其与2023年Roger Waters的《The dark side of the moon redux》中《Speak to me (redux)》的念白段落进行了关联，指出后者直接化用了《Free Four》的歌词。B面《The gold it's in the...》则被评价为轻松易记但略显平庸。作为单曲整体，评论者给予3/5星，认为作品有趣但相较于同期前卫摇滚并不算特别突出。Pink Floyd的录音品质和制作水准无需赘言，属于乐队的稳定输出。这张作品更多是作为电影配乐功能的载体，而非乐队最具实验野心的创作。

items.body:
First official reissue of fast and furious 7” anarcho-punk bullets by Nick Blinko and co. for CRASS side label Corpus Christi, newly remastered by Arthur Rizk from original tapes and clad in facsimile art.

‘The E.P's of R.P’ rounds up 23 blasts of punk first fired 1980-1982, in the years prior their landmark debut LP ‘Death Church’, and compiled in 1987, before it was bootlegged by punks who’d probably rather buy glue and special brew than pay thru the nose for legit copies. It’s frankly fucking feral yet properly disciplined punk that sowed seeds for hardcore to come, packing pure heck in mostly sub 1 min timeframes - they squeezed 12 tracks on their s/t debut 7”, and nearly as many on ‘Farce’, mad cunts! - and sounds fiercer than ever thanks to Arthur Rizk’s remaster...
items._cn_summary: 这张合辑收录了英国无政府朋克乐队 Rudimentary Peni 在1980至1982年间发行的三张7寸单曲作品，共23首短小精悍的曲目，由Arthur Rizk从原始母带重新母带处理。乐队主脑Nick Blinko以独特的视觉艺术风格著称，专辑封面采用忠实复刻的原版设计。音乐呈现出原始、粗粝且高度压缩的朋克能量，多数曲目时长不足一分钟，节奏急促密集，充满攻击性的人声和失真吉他riff。这批早于乐队首张全长专辑《Death Church》之前的作品被汇集成EP合辑，1987年首次发行后因正版价格高昂而被大量盗版。作为Crass旗下Corpus Christi厂牌的发掘，这些曲目记录了英国地下朋克场景的关键时期，为后来的硬核发展埋下种子，母带重制后声音更加凶猛清晰。

INTERNATIONAL（海外）
NEWS
豪州７都市を巡回「Japan Jazz Nights」
「日豪友好協力基本条約」署名50周年記念
2026年8月11日
編集部

「日豪友好協力基本条約」署名50周年を記念し2026年10月にオーストラリア７都市（アデレード、キャンベラ、シドニー、ホバート、パース、ブリスベン、メルボルン）を巡るジャズ巡回公演「Japan Jazz Nights」が予定されている。

この公演には、国際的にも注目を集める４組のアーティスト（BIGYUKI、STEREO CHAMP、Tenors In Chaos、梅井美咲）が出演、公演では一部、現地のアーティストとのコラボレーションも予定されており、音楽を通じて両国の相互理解を深め、日豪間の文化交流のさらなる発展を目指しているという。国際交流基金の交流事業の一環として実施される
